title: Actions
description: What a movement does to a structure, and when. Cross references, the role rule and the load-type rule are checked in pipeline/data/src/validate.ts.

applies_to.description: Who or what the claim holds for, when a source limits it, for example hips with pincer-type impingement.

when.description: Joint angle ranges in degrees. All entries must hold at once.

says_kind.description: quote when says is the source's own words (only for licences compatible with CC BY 4.0), summary when it is our own short summary.

checked_by.description: Null until a person has read the sources. Then a role label such as physio-1 or owner, never a name.

checked_on.description: The date the row was checked, like 2026-11-03. Required when checked_by is set, see validate.ts.

review_note.description: A question for the reviewer. Only the review build shows it.
